notes.title: Update: "The Collector" achievement fixed
notes.notes:
Hi Shifters,


We are happy to tell you that we finally found and fixed the bug related to "The Collector" achievement. You can now simply get it by entering a level and leaving it. 

Sorry again for the waiting. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519649/3e26aafaffcdf457ee04c283993df3ddf9877868.png[/img]

Thank you! 

-VirginRedemption

notes.title: FREE UPDATE: 3 new deadly blocks, 30 new levels, infinite hours of fun!
notes.notes:
Hey Shifters, 

During the development of Shift Quantum, we had to cut on a few gameplay blocks that remained in our “nice to have” list. We really loved them, so we continued to work on a few after releasing the game. Three of them are now finished and available for free in game. All you have to do is to launch the game, select the new branch in the menu called “Traps” and enjoy 30 new levels specially created to showcase these new traps. We hope that you will enjoy them as much as we did and can’t wait to see the deadly levels you will create using them in the level editor.

https://youtu.be/ipYx-CgDuvU

[h1]Update Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Laser block
[*]Burner block
[*]Spiky movable block
[*]New menu section
[*]30 new levels
[*]More search filters in the community tab
[*]Featured levels in the community tab
[/list]

Now tell us what’s your favorite gameplay block and what kind of block you imagine for the game? 

Thank you for the support! 

- VirginRedemption


PS: Don’t forget to join our Discord channel discord.gg/fishingcactus

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Dev Steam Page
notes.notes:
Hello Shifters, 

We recently fixed a few bugs and wanted to let you know. Please don't hesitate to let us know if you find more issues. 

[h1]Steam Patch notes: (patch 1.0.6)[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed issue causing player to fall off the world
[*]Fixed issues with player not dying from falling crates
[*]Fixed stability issues in the editor
[*]Updated time out to 15 seconds to fetch community levels
[*]Fixed update of black and white blocks that could sometimes be incorrectly set
[*]Removed default entry and exit door when creating a new level in the editor
[/list]

Also, Steam has a new functionality allowing developers and publishers to create their own Steam pages. We made one for Fishing Cactus, where we'll share info about all our coming games that don't have steam pages yet but also run contests to reward the community. Follow the dev page and comment its latest announcement in order to win prizes such as t-shirts and copies of our games. 

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/fishingcactus

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519649/42f2520e6871b09d8bf521429de583cc8cae78a9.png[/img]

Cheers :shiftheart:

notes.title: Release on May 30 worldwide!
notes.notes:
Hello Shifters, 

Great news! Shift Quantum, will launch on [b]PC, PlayStation 4, Switch, and Xbox One on May 29th in the United States and Canada, and May 30 worldwide[/b]. 

Two weeks ago we were at EGX Rezzed and asked players their thoughts about the game after playing it. Here's the verdict. 

https://youtu.be/GDE7GFCByXo

Also, we have a brand new gameplay trailer featuring music from the amazing soundtrack by Simon Felix Music & VolkorX! Enjoy!

https://youtu.be/ncp6qVpkIes

Can't wait! We hope you feel the same :)
